audit.sourcePolicy: Resolved shallow main commit and checked-out source are authoritative for this audit; package metadata is preserved as evidence.
audit.schoolCircleIntegrationDefinition: adapter-wired means current SchoolCircle/API source has an adapter or import and route for the repo; a clone or installed dependency alone is not integration.
audit.currentSourceStatus: All eleven JavaScript dependencies are pinned in artifacts/api-server/package.json at the reviewed SHAs. Core and evidence adapters, routes, and principal learner/instructor UI surfaces are present; UI paths are source-inspected only and final UI contract corrections remain in progress.

runtimeVerification.databaseStatus: Development Prisma baseline and LearningRecord migration are deployed. Labelled tests exercise real PostgreSQL LearningRecord roundtrip/CAS cleanup; no authenticated instructor end-to-end aggregate flow is claimed.
runtimeVerification.authStatus: Development auth readiness is true; /api/auth/user returns user:null and anonymous protected source access returns 401 AUTH_REQUIRED. No live OIDC callback or instructor identity is claimed.

testVerification.apiResult: 24 tests passed, including labelled PostgreSQL LearningRecord roundtrip/CAS cleanup and route tests

proxyProbes./api/learning/status: 200; auth.ready true; model/rubricon/whetstone/doctrine false; Prisma persistence present

runtimeVerification.uiVerification: Source inspection only; browser testing is not claimed and final UI contract corrections remain in progress.

repositories.name: anchor
localDeterministicCapabilities: retrieval and score gates with local fixtures
GroundingVerifier with injected ask_model or local verifier stub
API tests with injected pipeline state
externalRequirements: Python device requirements including FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pydantic, SQLite/sqlite-vec, and YAML support
local generator, embedding, and reranker services; optional HHEM verifier
Jetson/air-gapped deployment is the intended production environment
contractDrift: contract request uses q; actual Anchor request uses question
contract response names differ from actual abstain_reason, text, top_rerank_score, latency_s fields
contract /api/doctrine is the SchoolCircle wrapper, not an Anchor route

schoolCircleIntegration.notes: HTTP adapter posts to Anchor /api/ask, maps the response, preserves abstention, and reports an explicit unavailable state when DOCTRINE_BASE_URL is absent. This is source wiring only; Anchor is not configured or live-verified.

repositories.name: quarry
contractDrift: contract mentions PDF/POI bytes; source exposes PDF parsing and text task parsing, not a POI-specific parser
pageTexts is a pdfText result field, not a callable root export
pdfText returns pages and pageTexts in addition to text

schoolCircleIntegration.runtime: 24-test adapter/route suite passed with selected PostgreSQL persistence coverage; no instructor-authenticated live PDF flow is claimed
schoolCircleIntegration.notes: Quarry is loaded at the call boundary; page text, chunks, and citation pages are persisted in SOURCE records.

repositories.name: coursewright
localDeterministicCapabilities: full generation with an injected deterministic ask/fetch
externalRequirements: default generation requires an OpenAI-compatible model endpoint and COURSEWRIGHT_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY
contractDrift: contract signatures show separate objectives/docs arguments; source uses one spec object followed by emit and options
actual sections contain lesson, pre/post, flashcards, diagram, and per-artifact refusals beyond the generic map shape

schoolCircleIntegration.runtime: 24-test adapter suite passed with injected-model coverage; production draft still requires MODEL_BASE_URL, MODEL_ID, auth, and persistence
schoolCircleIntegration.notes: Calls Coursewright fromDocuments through the SchoolCircle model seam and persists draft/refusal data as PENDING until instructor approval.

repositories.name: sourcerer
externalRequirements: default ask path uses an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint
endpoint grounding mode requires an external HTTP service
contractDrift: contract shows ask({q,...}); actual API is ask(question,opts)
root exports normalizeEndpointResponse and summarizeFaithfulness in addition to map entries
verify intentionally throws for endpoint-only citations without passage text

schoolCircleIntegration.ui: No dedicated Sourcerer UI; the global Ask widget remains the separate Anchor /api/doctrine surface.
schoolCircleIntegration.runtime: 24-test adapter suite passed with injected-chat coverage and persistence/route tests; approved persisted passages, auth, persistence, and model are required for production
schoolCircleIntegration.notes: Sourcerer is called with approved passages and strict cite-or-refuse verification; refusals and citations are recorded as TUTOR_TURN.

contractDrift: isValidRubricShape is named by the contract but is not a root export

invalid task and model failure semantics do not satisfy the shared TypeError-only statement

schoolCircleIntegration.ui: No dedicated rubric UI is currently present.

schoolCircleIntegration.runtime: 24-test adapter suite passed with injected-model progression coverage; production requires MODEL_BASE_URL, MODEL_ID plus WHETSTONE_ENDPOINT, WHETSTONE_MODEL, WHETSTONE_API_KEY, auth, and persistence
schoolCircleIntegration.notes: Session state/transcript and terminal complete/stalled reports are serialized to MASTERY_SESSION and MASTERY_ATTEMPT. Whetstone is not configured or live-verified.
